verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no retention windows and no redaction or deletion API for collected identity data. Webhook Attribute Blocklists only filter fields out of outbound webhook payloads; that is an adjacent control and does not scrub stored PII. Data retention is a fair axis for an identity-verification platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can control what happens to collected identity data — documented retention windows and a redaction or deletion API that scrubs PII on demand
